description: API parameters per provider. Edit active_provider to switch. Override at runtime with AIFA_PROVIDER env var or --provider CLI arg.

_notes.thinking: gemini-2.5-pro supports thinking_budget. Add 'thinking_budget': 8000 to enable.

notes.why_low_temp: 0.2 keeps LLM grounded in provided scores. Increase to 0.4-0.5 if reports feel too robotic.
notes.why_16k_max_tokens: ~5K for thinking + ~5K for report. Leaves headroom for longer reports.
notes.why_adaptive_thinking: Claude extended thinking handles complex multi-step reasoning over the 30K token context.
